OBJECTIVE: Make Drug Repurposing a first-class LEGEND module: survey (A), adapter seam (B), the registry join (C), the feedback loop into research (D), proof on the real corpus (E). Mandate: disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/harness_mandate_20261022.md (operator-issued through the Orchestrator, 2026-10-22).

steps.step: A. Read-only survey note (at most two pages): 8 to 12 external tools across the seven evidence classes, five fields per row, a measured dry call or a recorded block for every ADOPT NOW, and what the scout log already covered
steps.evidence: disease-models/wwox/research/drug_repurposing/tool_survey_20261022.md (12 rows, 6 ADOPT NOW each with a measured dry call, 4 TRY, 2 WATCH; blocks table; scout-log coverage section) + tool_survey_20261022_drycalls.json (22 calls, 2026-10-22)

steps.step: A. Land on main, gate PASS on the exact SHA, safe_push to development

B. One adapter contract page in framework/protocols/ and one adapter directory under framework/ (path named with its reason); adapters declare name, inputs, outputs, network use, licence, retrieval-date stamping, self-test; plain-file registry; card format reused; CLI adapter list | add | remove | selftest

B. Regression removes every adapter in turn with the core still running; each ADOPT NOW adapter MEASURED green or a recorded block; scripts/test_tool_routing.py green; suites enrolled in run_release_regressions.py
C. Queries derived from claims, hypotheses, discovery ledger, mechanism lines and the pathograph export, each with its claim or locator of origin
C. Evidence table per query from receipts and manifests with depth, audit status (declarations + adjudication files) and the NOT WWOX EVIDENCE label

C. Cards composed from adapter hits plus the table (derived, never typed); a measure-next list per candidate; one command, deterministic, incremental, prints what changed; regressions enrolled; diff against a hand-made card in cards/

D. A short routed procedure (mode of an existing tool preferred) turning a module result into a Scientist assignment, a selection-file row or a hypothesis; one real result from C turned into one real row for the next batch

E. Run C on the three live axes (missense-class proteostasis, T-type calcium, downstream Wnt/MYC/GSK3/mTOR); report what the module found that the hand-made cards did not and what it missed; update README.md stage table and the reconciliation from measurement
E. Final report: self-evaluation per framework/protocols/session_self_evaluation.md, capability-scout entry, takeaways; land, gate, push

Dry calls for the survey use a public gene symbol (WWOX), a public Ensembl id and two public drug names only · no identifier of any person, no key, no spend · the mandate forbids keys and private data; a key-less read with public terms is the declared default · nothing would differ

The survey note keeps raw API payloads out of the repository (a compact per-call summary file is committed; the payloads stay in the session scratchpad) · payloads carry free text that the publication gate may flag and that nobody reads again · the measurement is reproducible from the command recorded in the note · a payload needed later is re-fetched with its date

OPERATOR_INSTRUCTIONS: 2026-10-22, received through the Orchestrator during deliverable A, binding every deliverable and overriding anything in the mandate file that reads more rigidly: lean, flexible, modular; patterns easy to implement and easy to remove; NO rigid contracts. Concretely for B: the adapter 'contract' is a one-page convention (a small function signature, a dict in and a dict out, a self-test), not a schema with validation layers, abstract base classes, registries kept in sync, or version fields; an adapter is one file dropped in or deleted with nothing else to edit; the CLI discovers adapters from the directory and requires no registration; no plugin framework, no dependency injection, no configuration language; plain Python modules and files over any infrastructure. Before adding anything: would deleting it later be a one-file act? If not, simplify until it is. Each stage report says what was NOT built for this reason.
NOT_BUILT_BY_DESIGN: A: no survey schema, no candidate registry, no scoring of tools; one Markdown note plus one JSON list of calls, both deletable without any other edit
